'''Kenata Dabyrie''' is a human found in the [[Arathi Highlands]]. She lives with her two sons [[Fardel Dabyrie|Fardel]] and [[Marcel Dabyrie|Marcel]] at the [[Dabyrie's Farmstead]]. [[Genavie Callow]] wants their heads because they stole her only precious belongings.<ref>{{Questlong|Horde|36|To Steal From Thieves}}</ref>

==Abilities==
*'''Disarm''' — Disarms an enemy, forcing it to stop wielding its weapon for 10 sec

==Quests==
* Drops [[Kenata's Head]] for {{Questlong|Horde|36|To Steal From Thieves}}.
